title: RAPID Matrix
description: Schema for a governance RAPID matrix mapping decision types to Recommend/Agree/Perform/Input/Decide roles. Alternative to RACI (see raci-matrix.schema.json) for clients with heavier cross-functional sign-off chains.

domain.description: Domain or council this RAPID matrix applies to.

agree.description: Role(s) whose sign-off is required before the decision can proceed (veto power).

perform.description: Role(s) who execute the decision once made.

input.description: Role(s) consulted for input but without veto power.

decide.description: Single role with final decision authority. Must be exactly one.
